an3.46:1.1: “Bhikkhus, when virtuous renunciants dwell in dependence on a village or a town,
an3.46:1.2: the people there generate much merit in three ways.
an3.46:1.5: When virtuous renunciants dwell in dependence on a village or a town,
an3.46:1.6: the people there generate much merit in these three ways.”
